metadata.description: A personal, portable kit of Claude Code skills — DevOps, SRE, cloud-governance and engineering-workflow skills packaged as installable plugins. Clone-free install on any machine.

plugins.name: ops-toolkit
plugins.description: Read-only, evidence-first triage & review: Kubernetes / EKS / ACK troubleshooting, incident root-cause analysis, and Dockerfile audit. Vendor-neutral, secret-free.

plugins.name: cloud-toolkit
plugins.description: Cloud governance: AWS/Aliyun cost review and least-privilege IAM/RAM auditing. Read-only, finds waste and over-broad permissions, outputs actionable fixes.

plugins.name: workflow-toolkit
plugins.description: Engineering workflow & output: structured ops sessions, long-task protocol, PR descriptions, architecture diagrams, shareable HTML reports, and browser e2e verification.
